# implement BFS over (node, time). allowed delta<=600, next event must occur after current time and <= current_time+600

def find_path(src, dst):
    from collections import deque
    visited = set()
    q = deque()
    # initial states: any event where src sent, at time t
    for (u,v,t) in window_events:
        if u==src:
            q.append((v,t,[(u,v,t)]))
            visited.add((v,t))
    while q:
        node, time, path = q.popleft()
        if node==dst:
            return path
        # consider subsequent events where node is sender at t2 with time>time and t2-time<=600
        for (v2,t2) in adj.get(node,[]):
            if t2>time and t2-time<=600 and (v2,t2) not in visited:
                visited.add((v2,t2))
                q.append((v2,t2,path+[(node,v2,t2)]))
    return None

path = find_path(1010,883)
print('\nfound path:', path)

            node = src
            q.append((node,t,[(u,v,t)]))
    visited=set()
    while q:

        if node==dst:
            return path
        for (v2,t2) in adj.get(node,[]):

                visited.add((v2,t2))
                q.append((v2,t2,path+[(node,v2,t2)]))
    return None
